misconceptions.description: Equating a good product with learning.
misconceptions.trigger: learner says 'the essay is good, so I learned it'
misconceptions.feedback: Learning comes from doing the thinking. A good product you did not think through may leave the skill unpracticed.

misconceptions.trigger: learner blames the tool for errors in submitted work
misconceptions.feedback: You choose what to submit, so you are responsible for it. Check before you use.
